description: Shared WebGPU minimum compute limits for Pixelocity's 14-entry bind group (bindings 0–13). TS imports this JSON (src/renderer/webgpuDevicePolicy.ts); C++ includes wasm_renderer/webgpu_limits.h, generated from it by `npm run gen:webgpu-limits`, and device.cpp CheckLimit + requiredLimits must use those constants (verify:device-policy fails on a stale header or a hardcoded literal).

notes.deepWorkgroupLimits: Requested on top of minimumComputeLimits only when the adapter reports all three at or above these values. WebGPU never grants more than requested, so without this a 1024-capable adapter still yields a 256-invocation device. supportsDeepWorkgroup is read from the device limits after creation, not the adapter. Mirrored in webgpuDevicePolicy.ts buildRequiredLimits(adapterLimits) and device.cpp adapterDeepWorkgroup.
notes.maxTextureDimension2D: Comfortable floor (WebGPU base limit is 8192; minimum viable 4096). Never derive this from maxBufferSize, pixel count, width*height, or a mis-ordered init arg / heap pointer.
notes.bufferSizeLimits: Floors (the WebGPU spec defaults). buildRequiredLimits(adapterLimits) requests the adapter's own value for each, never less than the floor, because a device only gets the spec default unless a higher value is requested. allowsFullWorkingSize (src/config/vramBudget.ts) needs device.limits.maxBufferSize >= 1 GiB for the 2048 working size. TypeScript only (cppMirror false): the WASM backend is frozen as R&D (docs/WASM_BACKEND_POLICY.md) and never offers the 2048 tier.
notes.limitsTiers: TypeScript limits tiers (#1512). A device is probed into every tier its granted limits reach: `base` (the real requirements of the 14-entry bind group and the 16x16 catalog workgroup: minimumComputeLimits, with maxTextureDimension2D checked at 4096 because the canvas and the working pool are at most 2048), `deep-workgroup` (deepWorkgroupLimits) and `big-buffer` (maxBufferSize >= 1 GiB, the 2048 working-size gate). buildRequiredLimits() requests a base limit only when it exceeds the spec default of the adapter's feature level, so a core device requests none of them (every base value is at or below the core default) and a compatibility device requests 256 invocations; maxTextureDimension2D is requested up to comfortableMaxTextureDimension2D when the feature level's default is lower. minimumComputeLimits itself stays the C++ mirror (webgpu_limits.h, device.cpp CheckLimit), which keeps the 8192 floor.
notes.specDefaults: WebGPU spec defaults per feature level for the limits the contract names (compatibility values as granted by a compatibility-mode device, e.g. Chromium's). Used only to decide what is worth requesting.
